name: Dwarven Thrower

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind

summary: +3 warhammer that can be thrown (20/60 ft) and flies back; an extra 1d8 when thrown (2d8 against Giants).
text: This magic weapon grants +3 to attack and damage rolls and has the Thrown property (normal range 20 feet, long range 60 feet). A ranged attack with it that hits adds 1d8 damage (2d8 against a Giant), and as soon as the attack resolves, the weapon flies straight back into your hand.
